Practical encoder qualification

2026-10-03 visual acceptance: PM has viewed and accepted all images. Practical qualification and the MFSK32 correction are accepted. Recorded decision and scope.

The same unchanged-encoder WAV is decoded independently by the public GramPy decoder and pinned Pi fldigi 4.2.13. Both receive the complete broadcast using automatic mode acquisition. Pictures appear at native size; use 2× to inspect blur.

Frozen screen: raw MAE ≤25/255; aligned MAE ≤20/255; channel bias ≤15/255; alignment offset ≤12 components and ≤12 changes. Correct text, headers, picture geometry and mode acquisition are required. Exact pixels are diagnostic.

GramPy automatic mode, used in this run, decodes MFSK64 pictures but skips MFSK32 pictures. Those three rows therefore test fldigi pictures and GramPy text only. A fixed-mode MFSK32 picture path exists but was not exercised here. Seven MFSK64 rows test both picture decoders.

Decoder correction, October 3: all three MFSK32 pictures now decode automatically. View source, previous output, corrected GramPy and Pi fldigi. This page retains the original qualification run.

10/10 cases pass the numerical and functional screen. PM visual review remains pending.
